1	import unittest
2	
3	from client import submit
4	from store import ReceiptUnavailable, Store
5	
6	
7	class SaveTests(unittest.TestCase):
8	    def test_save(self):
9	        store = Store()
10	        result = submit(store, "w", "op-1", {"color": "blue"})
11	        self.assertTrue(result["ok"])
12	        self.assertEqual(store.preferences["w"], {"color": "blue"})
13	
14	    def test_retry_same_values(self):
15	        store = Store()
16	        store.fail_receipt_once = True
17	        with self.assertRaises(ReceiptUnavailable):
18	            submit(store, "w", "op-1", {"color": "blue"})
19	        self.assertTrue(submit(store, "w", "op-1", {"color": "blue"})["ok"])
20	        self.assertEqual(store.preferences["w"], {"color": "blue"})
21	
22	    def test_completed_id_returns_receipt(self):
23	        store = Store()
24	        submit(store, "w", "op-1", {"color": "blue"})
25	        result = submit(store, "w", "op-1", {"color": "blue"})
26	        self.assertEqual(result, {"ok": True, "operation_id": "op-1"})
